author: Joe Scott
description:
Hey, feel like you’re missing out on videos? Sign up for my newsletter so you never miss a thing! https://thatjoescott.com/newsletter/

Ask any emergency room technician and they will tell you, things get crazier on nights with a full moon. In fact, stories about weird occurrences under full moons go back millennia, across cultures around the globe. But what do the studies actually say about this weird but seemingly universal phenomenon? The answer might surprise you.
